title: More on Dental-Medical Terminology
html: I am writing to express my opinion regarding the July JADA article titled “Medical Clearance Considerations for Medically Complex Adult Patients” (Sandhu S, Newsome L, Shazib MA. JADA. 2026;157[7]:716-726. doi:10.1016/j.adaj.2025.11.017). It is always encouraging to read articles that summarize the myriad complex medical conditions that we encounter as dental care professionals. This topic, and these considerations, are valuable reminders that a patient’s medical history is a critical component of any treatment plan.
